Consider this. It is unlikely to be a coincidence that this drumbeat of censorship from Huffpo and Reddit and twitter and now Youtube is ramping up even as the Presidential candidate Donald Trump rises in the polls.

The removal of pertinent Hillary Clinton scandal information, from her use of an unsecured Private Email server and unauthorized handheld devices to her lying/perjury to the Benghazi coverup to her Clinton Foundation corruption details and pay-to-play stint in the State department, all coincide with this radical uptick in censorship as carried forward by Youtube. And the censorship always starts with the claims of "public decency" and "civility" like a toe into the water to judge the temperature. Our reaction or lack of reaction, our level of complacency, is what is really being tested here.

But this is just the beginning. The censorship at Youtube and Twitter and Facebook will know no bounds if We the People don't make a stink about this. Action is required. Reddit is already out of control, right? So we need to propose the steps that will defend the public square from this censorship.

Step one is noting that YOUTUBE, FACEBOOK, TWITTER and other near-monopoly social media sites do, indeed, represent the PUBLIC SQUARE in this world of the 21st Century. The public square is where public speech takes place.

Step two is noting the power that we have. We the People have the right to police this space as we own the infrastructure and back bone of the medium and we paid our tax dollars to create it and, yep, our FCC is authorised to regulate this space. And I might also add that articles of incorporation are a GRANT from the public that can be rescinded. We the People have corporate power by the balls and have but to squeeze to make the Facebooks of the world dance to our tune.

Step three is bringing the Principles enshrined in the 1st Amendment to play as we regulate the opening up of Free Speech. Yes, the Constitution of the USA does apply to the Government but when we deal with near monopolies we are essentially dealing with a parallel government structure. Might I add that the Press, the 4th Estate, is specifically mentioned in the Constitution? Refer back to Step One, above, to realize that everything that makes the 1st Amendment important takes place at the level of the Public Square.

Congress must now get involved. Hearings are in order and we can make this a campaign issue.

We cannot sit passively by as the Public Square is monopolized and made un-free. Let us talk not just of the problem but of action moving forward
